headline: US Secures Direct Cobalt Supply from Congo, Bolstering Critical Mineral Supply Chains.
summary: A US firm has signed a direct supply deal with the Democratic Republic of Congo for cobalt, alongside plans for a domestic refining facility. This strategic move aims to diversify critical mineral supply chains, lessening global reliance on existing processing bottlenecks and impacting rare earth markets and geopolitical competition for resources essential to AI, EVs, and semiconductors.
